name: fapony
description: Token usage across Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex & ZCode on one yardstick — plus a project mem log and convention-debt tracker agents query via 3 MCP tools. No server, your data stays local
author: delamind (https://github.com/kire21b)

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test --timeout 20000 --parallel
scripts.release: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only && npm version patch -m 'release v%s' && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only && npm version minor -m 'release v%s' && git push origin main --follow-tags
